basic_details.short_information: Birla Institute of Technology and Science Pilani (BITS Pilani) has released an official notification for the recruitment of Junior Research Fellow Posts. Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-08-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BITS Pilani to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

Applications must be submitted online on or before 07-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani is 07 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted well before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Junior Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Master's degree in a relevant field or a BE/B.Tech degree along with at least 2 years of relevant experience to be eligible for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 37,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow position will involve an online or personal interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their performance in this interview.

faq.question: Q5. Is there an application fee for the BITS Pilani Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The official notification does not mention any specific application fee for the Junior Research Fellow recruitment. Candidates are advised to check the official website for any updates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this recruitment?
faq.answer: This is a project-based recruitment for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani.

faq.question: Q7. Can candidates from any state apply for this position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for BITS Pilani, Goa Campus. While there are no explicit state restrictions mentioned, candidates should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria and can attend the interview if required.

faq.question: Q8. What is the total number of vacancies for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position announced in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the Junior Research Fellow position at BITS Pilani must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application link?
faq.answer: The official notification and the application link can be found in the "Important Links" section of this article. Please use these links to access the required resources.
